author: KomodoLord1
body:
Hi Guys,
I know I haven't had time to really integrate in Avicus completely, everyone I have met so far are really kind and funny peeps. After the 
tournament and the recent dispansion of Crede, I have nothing to do and I'm kinda of looking for a team. I'll admit it I'm not the best at PVP (some of you might call me shocking) but I like to think I'm half-decent. I'm looking for any real team to give me a chance. Whilst I can't guarantee my PVP skills, I can for my commitement, I will always show up to as many scrims and tournaments as I possibly can.

Times I Can Play:

17:00-21:00 BST 
12:00-16:00 EST
And I can sometimes play a little in the mornings (no guarantee)

Position: I don't really know if you put me somewhere I will adapt and learn, but previously I have been Rusher or Defender
Past Teams: Used to play for NewDawn a little and Crede

The End

replies.author: aagrant99
replies.body: So modest.  You are decent at pvp but you lack in self esteem.  You have it in you. You have been with Avicus for awhile.  You have definitely integrated (it is quick and easy to become part of the community).  I vouch for you and encourage others to consider your acceptance into a team.  Kdr means very little into skill.  I once had a .6 kdr but improved it.  Practice makes perfect and you are improving.  It takes time to be og but you will get there.  I am not og but improved a lot over 4 years.  I have seen you before and you have done decent.  Even though you may not find  the strongest suit in pvp you definitely have commitment. Commitment can actually be more valuable than skill in the long term.  It guarantees a team always has a player and that the player in question will improve.
